This project is a SPA build with F# Bolero, a SPA library that compiles to WebAssembly. The project consists of a client and a server, both targeting .NET 10.0. The client uses Bolero for the frontend, while the server uses Bolero.Server to serve the Blazor WebAssembly application. The project also includes hot reload capabilities for both the client and server, allowing for a smoother development experience. The client and server projects reference each other, enabling seamless integration between the frontend and backend.

The project is a pure SPA with no servers-side state. All state is managed in the `localStorage` of the browser, and the server is only responsible for serving the static files of the Blazor WebAssembly application. The project does not include any API endpoints or server-side logic, making it a simple and lightweight SPA example.
